description: This file is a shell script designed as a test runner for the 'L1' testing workflow in a CI/CD pipeline, mainly involved in cloning repositories, ensuring specific refs are checked out, and applying patches to specific directories.

methods.name: ensure_repo_cloned
methods.description: Ensures that a Git repository exists at a specified directory and is checked out at the specified ref. Clones or fetches as needed, with fallback to a full clone if a shallow clone fails.

methods.name: ensure_l1_workflow_repos_present
methods.description: Clones required repositories for the L1-tests workflow, using specific refs, excluding a particular framework repo.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point initializes the workspace, ensures necessary repos are present, and applies patches if possible.
